reviewBasis: Every field reviewed directly against canonical Japanese; no peer outputs read.
terminologyChecks: Nominal diameter kept distinct from measured outside and inside diameters; A/B retained.
Threaded, welded, and mechanical joining kept distinct.
Cut-face condition, length, cutting tools, and gauge inspection kept distinct.
Thread engagement and tightening distinguished from sealing and leak tests.
Curing and pressurization conditions preserved without adding waiting times or torque values.
Gas welding and shielded metal arc welding distinguished; V/Y/I shapes retained.
Tack welding distinguished from final welding and inspection.
Mechanical retention distinguished from gasket sealing.
PVC insertion marks distinguished from actual insertion; holding time distinguished from curing.
Internal lining distinguished from external coating and pipe-end corrosion protection.
correctionsDuringSelfReview: Clarified that gloves and clothing are drawn into rotating parts in Vietnamese.
Clarified the English wording about the mere presence of resin without changing the condition.
limitations: Self-reviewed translation only; no native-speaker review or external technical certification.
